data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: python3 -m dso_ci_review.runner with fixture diff produces valid reviewer-findings.json
- DD3: Pre-migration golden corpus checked-in as deterministic baseline

## Implementation
Create plugins/dso/scripts/pyproject.toml (litellm==<exact>, respx==<exact> test dep), dso_ci_review/__init__.py, runner.py (reads diff from stdin/env, calls providers/anthropic, writes findings JSON; DSO_CI_REVIEW_DRY_RUN=1 for test mode), providers/__init__.py, providers/anthropic.py (wraps litellm.completion with deferred import). Also modify tests/skills/run-python-tests.sh to pip-install the package before pytest (fail-open). Create corpus fixtures: anthropic-request.json, anthropic-response.json.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes (litellm installed, smoke test GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "import dso_ci_review.runner" succeeds
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "import dso_ci_review.runner"
- [ ] pyproject.toml exists with exact litellm pin (no ~= or >=)
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/scripts/pyproject.toml && ! grep -E "(~=|>=).*litellm" plugins/dso/scripts/pyproject.toml
- [ ] smoke test passes GREEN
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py::test_runner_produces_findings_json -x
- [ ] corpus fixtures exist and are valid JSON
  Verify: python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/anthropic-response.json'))"
- [ ] pip install block present in run-python-tests.sh
  Verify: grep -q "pip install" tests/skills/run-python-tests.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
data.title: Create dso_ci_review Python package skeleton + golden corpus fixtures
